title: Descent of a syntomic algebra map along a directed colimit of base rings
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed set and $(R_i)_{i\in I}$ a directed system of commutative rings, with compatible unital transition homomorphisms $R_i\to R_j$ for $i\leq j$, and colimit $R=\varinjlim_i R_i$ in commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Fix $i_0\in I$, commutative $R_{i_0}$-algebras $B_0,C_0$, and an $R_{i_0}$-algebra homomorphism $\varphi_0:B_0\to C_0$ of finite presentation [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra]. For $i\geq i_0$ set $B_i=R_i\otimes_{R_{i_0}}B_0$, $C_i=R_i\otimes_{R_{i_0}}C_0$, and let $\varphi_i=1\otimes\varphi_0:B_i\to C_i$; put $B=R\otimes_{R_{i_0}}B_0$, $C=R\otimes_{R_{i_0}}C_0$ and $\varphi=1\otimes\varphi_0:B\to C$. Assume that $\varphi$ is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], of finite presentation, and that for every prime $\mathfrak p\subset B$ its fibre ring $C\otimes_B\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] is a local complete intersection over $\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ [def-weil-pbc-complete-intersection-over-field]. Then there exists $i\geq i_0$ such that $\varphi_i$ is flat, of finite presentation, and for every prime $\mathfrak p_i\subset B_i$ the fibre ring $C_i\otimes_{B_i}\kappa(\mathfrak p_i)$ is a local complete intersection over $\kappa(\mathfrak p_i)$. No finite-presentation assumption on $R_{i_0}\to B_0$ or $R_{i_0}\to C_0$ is imposed.
